name: voice-avatar
description: An avatar band above the prompt and a detailed pane for the voice plugin: who speaks (Piper, another voice agent, a 3D scene), whether Claude listens and to whom, the microphone's level, and what Claude is doing. It only reads the voice plugin's local state files

language.title: Language
language.description: fr or en: the language of the band and the pane (French for fr, English otherwise). Set it as the voice plugin's language option

faceFile.title: 3D bot face file
faceFile.description: Off when empty (the default). A JSON file a 3D scene polls to mirror the avatar: Claude's state (idle, working, waiting, done, failed) and its tool's name, never a prompt, an argument or a path

faceSession.title: Session name in the face file
faceSession.description: The name the face file gives this session
